note: Influence and approval are gameplay starting values for 1 January 2000 (Liberal majority government under Jean Chretien), not measured data. Influence reflects institutional weight: strong business and resource-sector lobbies, a sizeable union movement, provincial and Quebec interests carried mainly through regional parties, and a small civilian-controlled military.

interest_groups.note: Small all-volunteer forces after 1990s budget cuts.
Business groups broadly supported the deficit reduction of the late 1990s and NAFTA.
The Canadian Labour Congress is affiliated with the NDP.
Western and rural ridings largely voted Reform in 1997.
Includes francophone Quebec, First Nations, Inuit and Metis, and immigrant communities.
